chunks: And he said, peace be upon him and his family:
"When the pilgrim casts the pebbles at the Jamarat, he comes out from his sins."

key_terms.ٱلْجِمَارَ: the Jamarat, the ritual stoning sites in hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual effect of casting the pebbles at the Jamarat during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when the pilgrim performs the rite of casting at the Jamarat, he is released from his sins. It highlights the spiritual purification associated with the rites of hajj and the mercy of Allah bestowed through acts of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2196 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"When the pilgrim casts the pebbles at the Jamarat, they are cleansed of their sins."
